description:
Get the Site Audit (crawler) detail for a single crawled URL from the latest crawl. Returns status_code, crawl_depth, indexability_score (0–100), health_score, title, meta_description, category_scores (onPage/crawlability/indexability/internationalSeo/technical/social/structuredData/sitemaps — structuredData, sitemaps, and internationalSeo are null on crawls that predate those categories or never stored International page facts), issue_counts {critical, warning, notice}, and issues[] — the page's failing checks, each with issue_code, title, severity (critical|warning|notice), category, description (the per-page finding) and how_to_fix. NOTE: the crawler does not store canonical, H1, word count, internal-link counts, response time or byte size, so those are not returned. Returns page_not_found when the URL was not part of the latest crawl. Defaults to the most-recently-finished audit; pass the auditId argument (an audit_id from list_site_audit_projects) to target a specific one. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties, and url = the exact page URL (as shown by list_site_audit_issue_pages or page_explorer).

Cost: 3 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// Technical detail + issues for a single page from the latest site audit crawl.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","url":"https://example.com/pricing"}
```
name: get_site_audit_page
title: Crawled page detail
